== What's Yours is Ours ==
Speak to [[Agne]] to roll the dice.

Gamble with [[Agne]]

=== Description ===
Hey pal, watch it!

Oh, what's this? A proper customer, eh?

Welcome to Quark's Shack. You here for business or pleasure?

You see, this here is a bar of mine made for coin connoisseurs, so if you're here, then it's time to grab some quick coin and also have some fun you're at it.

If you're looking to gamble, then speak to Agne. She handles the bones. What, you never rolled the dice before? Nah, no need to worry about your coins, pal. You'll make back your losses in no time! Now, if you need anything to widen your eyes and numb your thoughts, come back and see me.

=== Progress ===
Hey there, sweetie. Wanna play a quick game of chance with your local beauty, Agne?

=== Completion ===
The early investor reaps the most interest.

=== Gains ===
Upon completion of quests, get:

100 Experience

150 Reputation with

75 Reputation with [Orgrimmar]
